description: A make-like build utility for Ruby.

option.name: --all
tip: Show all tasks, even uncommented ones (in combination with -T or -D).

option.name: --backtrace
tip: Enable full backtrace.
OUT can be stderr (default) or stdout.

option.name: --build-all
tip: Build all prerequisites, including those which are up-to-date.

option.name: --comments
tip: Show commented tasks only.

option.name: --describe
tip: Describe the tasks (matching the optional PATTERN), then exit.

option.name: --directory
tip: Change to DIRECTORY before doing anything.

option.name: --dry-run
tip: Do a dry run without executing actions.

option.name: --execute
tip: Execute some Ruby code and exit.

option.name: --execute-continue
tip: Execute some Ruby code, then continue with normal task processing.

option.name: --execute-print
tip: Execute some Ruby code, print the result, then exit.

option.name: --help
tip: Display this help message.

option.name: --job-stats
tip: Display job statistics.
LEVEL=history displays a complete job list.

option.name: --jobs
tip: Specify the maximum number of tasks to execute in parallel.
(default is number of CPU cores + 4)

option.name: --libdir
tip: Include LIBDIR in the search path for required modules.

option.name: --multitask
tip: Treat all tasks as multitasks.

option.name: --no-deprecation-warnings
tip: Disable the deprecation warnings.

option.name: --no-search
tip: Do not search parent directories for the Rakefile.

option.name: --no-system
tip: Use standard project Rakefile search paths, ignore system wide rakefiles.

option.name: --prereqs
tip: Display the tasks and dependencies, then exit.

option.name: --quiet
tip: Do not log messages to standard output.

option.name: --rakefile
tip: Use FILENAME as the rakefile to search for.

option.name: --rakelibdir
tip: Auto-import any .rake files in RAKELIBDIR.
(default is 'rakelib')

option.name: --require
tip: Require MODULE before executing the rakefile.

option.name: --rules
tip: Trace the rules resolution.

option.name: --silent
tip: Like --quiet, but also suppresses the 'in directory' announcement.

option.name: --suppress-backtrace
tip: Suppress backtrace lines matching the regexp PATTERN.
Ignored if --trace is on.

option.name: --system
tip: Use system wide (global) rakefiles (usually '~/.rake/*.rake').

option.name: --tasks
tip: Display the tasks (matching the optional PATTERN) with descriptions, then exit.
-AT displays all tasks, including those without descriptions.

option.name: --trace
tip: Turn on invoke/execute tracing and enable full backtrace.
OUT can be stderr (default) or stdout.

option.name: --verbose
tip: Log messages to standard output.

option.name: --version
tip: Display the program version.

option.name: --where
tip: Describe the tasks (matching the optional PATTERN), then exit.
